description: Send a whole UK tenancy agreement or employment document to Contract Lily for a full review, with the user's agreement to send it. Pass the attached file, or else the document's complete text, word for word; a summary or excerpt gives a wrong review. It returns a reviewId for get_contract_review. The review reads the document against UK law and returns a verdict, findings and a PDF report. Results are recommendations, not legal advice.

family.description: The kind of contract: a home tenancy, or an employment document.

text.description: The document's complete text, word for word with its clause numbers, when no file can be passed. Never a summary or an excerpt.

name: start_contract_review
title: Start a contract review
